title: Deerwood Estates, Killeen, TX - By Brian E Adams, Realtor with StarPointe Realty
description:
Deerwood Estates is a small executive community in Killeen just off of Stagecoach road, on the border of Harker Heights.  It is walking distance from the Purser Family park and new YMCA.  Deerwood features large homes – the smallest being around 2400 square feet – on large half acre to one acre lots.  These homes were predominantly built between 2007 and 2014 by Carothers Homes, and many are sprawling and luxurious single story estates.  The neighborhood is a great fit for anyone looking for high end custom homes from one of the area’s best builders, but still convenient to the amenities of Killeen and Harker Heights.
